HN Show 的标题解析失败了（该 feed 的 title 含 CDATA）。修正并提取，然后做最终汇总表。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
 "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "function clean(s){return String(s||'').replace(/<!\\[CDATA\\[/g,'').replace(/\\]\\]>/g,'').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim();}",
 "(async function(){",
 " const r=await get('https://hnrss.org/show?points=100');",
 " const items=r.body.split('<item>').slice(1);",
 " console.log('=== HN Show (>=100pts) ===');",
 " for(const it of items){",
 " const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(it);",
 " const l=/<link>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/link>/.exec(it);",
 " console.log(' • '+clean(t?t[1]:'?')+' | '+clean(l?l[1]:''));",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-hnr2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-hnr2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Parse HN Show titles with CDATA handling", timeoutMs: 200000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 5000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
  "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "function clean(s){return String(s||'').replace(/<!\\[CDATA\\[/g,'').replace(/\\]\\]>/g,'').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim();}",
  "(async function(){",
  "  const r=await get('https://hnrss.org/show?points=100');",
  "  const items=r.body.split('<item>').slice(1);",
  "  console.log('=== HN Show (>=100pts) ===');",
  "  for(const it of items){",
  "    const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(it);",
  "    const l=/<link>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/link>/.exec(it);",
  "    console.log('  • '+clean(t?t[1]:'?')+'  |  '+clean(l?l[1]:''));",
  "  }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-hnr2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-hnr2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Parse HN Show titles with CDATA handling", timeoutMs: 200000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 5000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
